function: IRS-NN learns IRS phase-shift (DFT codebook) selection from partially sampled cascaded channels, jointly with UAV trajectory and SN association, minimizing weighted AoI and UAV energy (pp. 1, 8).
system: Semi-passive reflecting IRS (10x10 UPA, 6 active sensing elements), UAV at 60 m, 5 ground sensor nodes; UAV and SN antennas and carrier band not stated (pp. 5, 11).
method: Dual-network agent (UAV-NN, IRS-NN; fully connected) inside PPO (PPO-RAC) and DQN (DQN-RAC); deep reinforcement learning, 50,000 training episodes with Adam (pp. 8-11).
data_channel: Custom simulation: probabilistic LoS with Rician SN-UAV and SN-IRS links, LoS IRS-UAV link, noisy samples from active IRS elements; no standardized, public, or measured data (pp. 5-7).
test_conditions: 50,000 training episodes in one simulated 300x400 m area; AoI swept over active elements, packet size, SNs, IRS size, transmit power; no unseen-scenario test stated (pp. 11-14).
baselines: All DRL: PPO-Dual (decoupled agents), PPO-Ideal (perfect CSI), PPO and DQN with AO training, No-IRS PPO; no non-learned method such as random or fixed IRS phases (p. 11).
metrics: Average AoI of sensor nodes, UAV energy consumption, average reward and convergence over episodes (pp. 11-14).
complexity: Order of multiplications, sum over layers of input times output units, for actor and critic networks of PPO-RAC and DQN-RAC; no numbers or runtime (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 5: "model for large-scale fading and the Rician channel model for" small-scale fading, a custom simulator with probabilistic LoS. No 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100, or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 11: "All algorithms were trained for" 50000 episodes; p. 13: "Fig. 8 when the number of SNs increases from 5 to 20" is a sweep. The paper never states that an agent trained under one setting is tested under another.
q3_support: p. 11: "7) No IRS: A baseline scheme using only PPO for UAV" trajectory; p. 11: "The variant of PPO-RAC trained with the alternating optimization (AO) method". Every baseline is a DRL variant; no non-learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 10: "the number of multiplications performed in each iteration" under Complexity Analysis, giving the order O(sum of input times output units over layers) for PPO-RAC and DQN-RAC.
q5_support: p. 10: "In simulations, we consider a rectangular target area of" 300m x 400m, so all data are simulated. No code or data link appears, and no public or measured dataset is used.
notes: Area 6 follows the tie-break order (6 before 3): the learned control acts on an aerial UAV link and the IRS phase control is its beam control; area 3 applies if the IRS phase design alone is taken as decisive, so the reviewer may confirm. UAV trajectory and SN association are above the physical layer, so the work passes above_phy only through the IRS-NN phase decision. All baselines are DRL schemes, so q3 is 0; PPO-Ideal aligns the IRS phases with perfect CSI as an upper bound (p. 11), not as a baseline to beat, and PPO-Dual and the AO variants are the proposed networks trained in another way. The q4 formula is generic, without numeric values or runtime.
